Requirement line: US federal standards for protecting health information, regulated by the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
Data handling · Risk area · Breach notic:
Data handling: Electronic protected health information (ePHI), meaning personal information about health, disability and healthcare services, is handled in line with HIPAA.
Risk area: Breach of protected health information or of HIPAA requirements.
Breach notice: After a breach of unsecured protected health information, covered entities notify affected individuals, the HHS Secretary and, in some cases, the media. Business associates notify the covered entity.
Used in: ISP, AUP, RMF, IRP, DCP, ACP

Requirement line: EU law on data protection and privacy in the EU and European Economic Area, regulated by the European Data Protection Board.
Data handling · Risk area · Breach notic:
Data handling: Data collected from people in the EU is handled under GDPR, following the terms and commitments in the company's Privacy Policy.
Risk area: Breach of the General Data Protection Regulation.
Breach notice: Article 33: notify the supervisory authority without undue delay and, where feasible, within 72 hours of becoming aware, unless the breach is unlikely to put individuals' rights and freedoms at risk. Article 34: tell affected individuals without undue delay when the risk to them is high.

Requirement line: California's state-wide privacy law, regulated by the California Privacy Protection Agency.
Data handling · Risk area · Breach notic:
Data handling: Data collected from California residents is handled under the CCPA, following the terms and commitments in the company's Privacy Policy.
Risk area: Breach of the California Consumer Privacy Act.
Breach notice: Notify any California resident whose unencrypted personal information was, or is reasonably believed to have been, acquired by an unauthorised person. Notify the Attorney General when more than 500 residents are affected.

Requirement line: Australia's open data regime, regulated by the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC), with minimum information security, privacy and assurance reporting requirements.
Data handling · Risk area · Breach notic:
Data handling: CDR data is kept within the defined CDR data environment and handled under the CDR rules and the CDR policy.
Risk area: Consumer Data Right data breach, or non-compliance with the rules.
Breach notice: Notify affected consumers and the OAIC as under the Australian Privacy Act, and notify the Australian Cyber Security Centre as soon as practicable and no later than 30 days after the incident.
Used in: ISP, AUP, RMF, IRP, DCP, PVP

Requirement line: Privacy rights of Australian consumers, regulated by the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC).
Data handling · Risk area · Breach notic: Breach notice: Notifiable Data Breaches scheme: assess a suspected breach within 30 days, and notify affected individuals and the OAIC when it is likely to cause serious harm.

Requirement line: The Australian Prudential Regulation Authority's (APRA) minimum information security requirements for regulated entities and their suppliers.
Governs how organisations collect, store, use and share personal information in New Zealand; administered by the Ministry of Justice.
Sets how private-sector organisations collect, use and disclose personal information in commercial activities across Canada, regulated by the Office of the Privacy Commissioner.
The library covers the Colorado Privacy Act, which gives Colorado residents the right to opt out of targeted advertising, the sale of their personal data and certain profiling.
Data handling · Risk area · Breach notic: For another state, confirm which law applies and add its line.

Requirement line: Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act 2012, a baseline standard of protection for personal data, enforced by the Personal Data Protection Commission.
Attestation reports on the company's security, availability, confidentiality, processing integrity and privacy practices, to meet customer requirements.
Data handling · Risk area · Breach notic: Name only the criteria in Framework Scope.

Requirement line: The global standard for an effective information security management system, certified to meet customer requirements.
Data handling · Risk area · Breach notic: Switches on the ISMS wording, communication plan, Statement of Applicability, internal audit and corrective-actions statements.

Requirement line: Reports on general IT controls that cover Sarbanes-Oxley requirements (SOX ITGC), to meet customer requirements.
Voluntary standards, guidelines and best practices for managing cybersecurity risk, for management and customer assurance.

Requirement: Customer contracts, Terms of Service, Privacy Policy
Requirement line: Customer contracts set specific information security and privacy responsibilities and requirements. The Terms of Service set out the company's responsibilities to users. The Privacy Policy sets out its privacy commitments and the rights of data subjects.
Data handling · Risk area · Breach notic: Customer contracts are always listed; the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy when the client has published them. No policy setting may be weaker than a commitment.

Requirement line: Environmental, social and governance reporting, for transparency and public commitment to positive impact.
Data handling · Risk area · Breach notic: No brain field. Include only if the client reports on ESG; it also switches on the ESG wording in the Code of Conduct, Risk Management Framework and Vendor Risk Management Framework.
